name: @equin/plugin-tasks-orchestration-mandate
description: The mandate: a policy on a task stating what an agent may do inside its subtree, resolved nearest-wins up the folder tree. Core: the capability catalog value (the policy types are the policy leaf). Server: the Mandate.Capability registry, mandateOf / grantOf, granted(cap) for Mcp.tool.when, the mandate instructions section, and the mandates collection + capability catalog for Debug.
